title: I was today-years-old when I found out about Mallworld
content: I've had dreams about wandering through a public restroom, trying to find a toilet that wasn't clogged and over flowing, out of toilet paper, or had stall walls only three feet high. The restrooms go on and on and are full of people who don't seem to have a problem with the state of the facilities. I've also have dreams of needing to use the restroom, only to find that toilet is in a regular room without privacy. Now I'm finding out that other people have had similar experiences and they even describe the restrooms exactly how I see them.
